name: Chicken vindaloo-style sauce (vinegar-chile-spice, no pork)
status: PRELIMINARY ESTIMATE — NOT COOKED OR TASTED
shelf_life_note: 3 days at ≤ 5 °C (ASSUMPTION: set by a food-safety professional)
method: Blend onion, ginger, garlic, toasted chiles, spices and vinegar to a paste.
Cook the paste in oil 15 min, add passata, jaggery, salt and water; simmer 15 min to a thick sauce.
Cool in shallow pans; chill. Chicken is added and braised separately in the dish recipe.
evidence: Practice: vindaloo derives from Portuguese carne de vinha d'alhos; the Goan version is a vinegar-and-chile marinade/braise traditionally with pork (web-search snippet level). NASHA uses CHICKEN ONLY (D-54: no pork).
estimates_label: All quantities, yields, times and costs are preliminary estimates until a person cooks and measures them. Nothing here has been cooked or tasted.
